important_limitations: The registered frames are reconstructed deterministically and are not stored output images from the original algorithm execution.
Pixel-difference panels can include intensity changes, blurring and occlusions; TRE is evaluated from offline geometry rather than visually estimated from difference images.
No independent human reviewer has provided signoff; additional human review is recommended before formal publication or safety-critical use.
review_result: No obvious rendering or status/provenance mismatch in the ten inspected panels; failure cases are retained.
scope: Ten case panels as rendered; observational manual screen review, not independent human signoff or an original saved backend registered-image inspection
